reviews.text: Felt very hydrating and cooling. Stayed on my skin better than other masks I’ve tried, but still not perfectly.
reviews.zh: 感覺非常保濕而且涼涼哋。比起我試過嘅其他面膜更貼服，但都仲未算完全貼服。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Snail Skin Barrier Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: This mask is perfect for skin rehabilitation and calming down redness. The essence is rich but not sticky, and it leaves my skin feeling incredibly hydrated and soft. The sheet itself is thin and adheres very well to the face, ensuring all the goodness is absorbed. It’s very gentle on my sensitive, acne-prone skin and helps strengthen the skin barrier. A must-have for a healthy glow!
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜非常適合修復肌膚同埋紓緩泛紅。精華豐富但唔黏笠，用完之後皮膚感覺超級保濕又柔軟。面膜紙本身好薄，緊貼面部，確保所有精華都俾皮膚吸收。對我呢種敏感肌同暗瘡肌嚟講好溫和，有助強化肌膚屏障。係想擁有健康光澤必備嘅面膜！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Snail Skin Barrier Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I have oily skin, so I’m usually careful with sheet masks because they often make my face even shinier. This one didn’t. My skin felt hydrated but not greasy, and it didn’t clog my pores. I used it in the evening and my skin looked fresh the next morning
reviews.zh: 我係油性肌，所以一向對片裝面膜比較小心，因為好多時都會令到我塊面更油光。呢款就唔會。皮膚感覺到保濕但唔油笠，亦冇堵塞毛孔。我夜晚用完，第二朝起身皮膚望落好 fresh。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Snail Skin Barrier Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: The mask was good and I liked it. I didn’t notice a big visible change, but my skin felt smoother and softer after using it. My face felt cleaner and more refreshed, and overall the mask felt nice on the skin. It was a pleasant experience.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜好好，我自己都好鍾意。雖然我冇留意到好大嘅明顯變化，但用完之後皮膚感覺更滑更柔軟。成塊面感覺更乾淨、更清爽，整體嚟講敷上面嘅感覺好舒服。係一次愉快嘅體驗。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Snail Skin Barrier Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I absolutely love the SOME BY MI Real Snail Skin Barrier Care Sheet Mask! It deeply hydrates and helps repair my skin barrier, leaving my face feeling soft, plump, and refreshed. The essence feels nourishing without being heavy, and my skin looks healthier and more radiant after each use. It’s perfect for calming and restoring tired or sensitive skin. 🐌✨
reviews.zh: 我完全愛上咗 SOME BY MI Real Snail Skin Barrier Care Sheet Mask！佢能夠深層保濕，有助修復我嘅肌膚屏障，用完之後塊面感覺柔軟、飽滿又清爽。精華感覺滋潤但唔厚重，每次用完皮膚望落更健康、更有光澤。非常適合用嚟鎮靜同修復疲倦或敏感肌膚。🐌✨
